title: Building an Engine Console
summary: A Quake-style console: coloured engine log with level and text filters, smart auto-scroll, a pinned command line, a small command parser, history on Up/Down and Tab completion.

options: InputText returns true only when Enter is pressed, instead of on every edit
The text is cleared on Enter
Focus stays on the field after Enter
quiz.explain: Without the flag, InputText returns true whenever the text changes. Focus is NOT kept automatically, which is why the console calls SetKeyboardFocusHere(-1) afterwards.

quiz.q: Why does the console only call SetScrollHereY(1.0f) when GetScrollY() >= GetScrollMaxY()?
options: So it follows new lines only if the user was already at the bottom, and doesn't yank them away while they read older lines
quiz.explain: Sticky auto-scroll: at the bottom you follow the stream, scrolled up you stay put.

quiz.q: Inside the history callback, how should you replace the current line?
quiz.explain: While active, InputText owns an internal copy of the text. The callback helpers keep the buffer, length, cursor and internal state consistent. Never replace the Buf pointer.

quiz.q: The log child is created with height -footer. What does the negative height mean?
options: Fill the available height minus footer pixels, leaving room for the input line
quiz.explain: Negative sizes in BeginChild mean 'all remaining space minus this amount', the same convention as negative item widths.
